title: {p} & {v} Noodle Soup
steps: Soften the {v} with the {spice} in a large pot with a little oil.
Add the {sauce}, the {p} and enough water to cover, then simmer 20 to 25 minutes, until any meat is at least 165°F / 74°C inside.
Lift out any whole pieces of meat, shred them and return them to the pot.
Stir in the {s}, simmer until just tender, and finish with lemon or fresh herbs.
tip: Load it with veg, use plenty of broth and fewer noodles, and keep the salt low.
